Select distinct rows on a subset of columns

Source: R/select-filter-helpers.R
select_unique.Rd

Shorthand for select(...) %>% unique() %>% droplevels() — used to build the small per-comparison data frames consumed by plot_upset_batch() and similar overlap helpers.

Usage

select_unique(input, ...)

Arguments

input

A data frame.

...

Columns to select, forwarded to dplyr::select() (tidy evaluation).

Value

input restricted to the selected columns, with duplicate rows removed and unused factor levels dropped.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
select_unique(pep_all, Condition, Sequence)
} # }
